title: 7-Day Attendance Recovery & Study Habit Reset
description: Protocol for students with attendance dropping below 75%. Focuses on morning check-ins, asynchronous session catch-up, and attendance contract agreements.
action_items: Schedule mandatory 15-min morning check-in with assigned mentor.
Review recorded session archives for missed classes during the last 14 days.
Commit to a minimum 90% attendance target for the next 2 consecutive weeks.

title: Critical Absence Intervention & Accountability Pairing
description: Urgent intervention for severe attendance deficits (< 50%). Assigns a peer accountability partner and emergency mentor escalation.
action_items: Emergency 1-on-1 counseling session with student success manager.
Pair with a high-performing peer mentor for daily attendance ping.
Complete mandatory Attendance Recovery Assessment by Friday.

title: 100-Minutes Daily Hands-on Coding Challenge
description: Structured daily coding blueprint for students logging under 8 hours of weekly coding practice. Focuses on core logic building and pair programming.
action_items: Dedicate a fixed 2-hour daily block for uninterrupted hands-on coding.
Solve 2 Easy and 1 Medium algorithm problems daily on LeetCode/HackerRank.
Push all code commits daily to GitHub to maintain active green streak.

resources.name: 30 Days of JS & Python Logic Drills

title: Full-Stack Project Building & Debugging Sprint
description: Accelerated coding methodology to turn conceptual knowledge into working software applications.
action_items: Build one mini CRUD project using React and FastAPI backend.
Practice debugging with browser developer tools and print logs.
Submit project for peer code review on community Discord.

title: Assignment Catch-Up & Test Review Sprint
description: Remediation plan for test scores below 70% or missing assignment submissions. Includes targeted topic reviews and mock quizzes.
action_items: Re-take practice quizzes for lowest performing topic modules.
Complete and submit all overdue assignments before weekly deadline.
Attend Thursday evening TA office hours for Q&A review.

title: Portfolio Capstone Project Launchpad
description: Framework for students with fewer than 2 completed projects to build deployment-ready portfolio applications.
action_items: Select a capstone project idea from the curated industry project library.
Implement REST API backend endpoints and modern responsive frontend.
Deploy live application on Vercel/Render and feature on LinkedIn profile.

title: Mock Technical Interview & Systems Design Mastery
description: Targeted preparation strategy for students logging low interview practice hours (< 4 hrs/week). Focuses on behavioral & technical interviews.
action_items: Conduct at least 2 mock technical interviews with peers on Pramp or MockInterview.
Practice STAR method answers for top 10 technical behavioral questions.
Review resume with placement counselor and refine project descriptions.
